summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Rosaline Patricia Irorefe Bozimo, a Nigerian lawyer born 1 January 1946. It records her appointment as Chief Justice of Delta State from 23 March 2003, her retirement on 1 January 2011, and her succession by Honorable Justice Abiodun Smith.
one_line: Nigerian lawyer who served as Chief Justice of Delta State from 2003 until her retirement in 2011.
key_facts: Rosaline Patricia Irorefe Bozimo was born on 1 January 1946.
Rosaline Patricia Irorefe Bozimo is a Nigerian lawyer.
Rosaline Patricia Irorefe Bozimo was appointed Chief Justice of Delta State with effect from 23 March 2003.
Rosaline Patricia Irorefe Bozimo retired as Chief Justice of Delta State on 1 January 2011.
Honorable Justice Abiodun Smith succeeded Rosaline Patricia Irorefe Bozimo as Chief Justice of Delta State.
Delta State is the state in Nigeria where Rosaline Patricia Irorefe Bozimo held the office of Chief Justice.
